title: *Why Not Bolivia?* - Marginal REVOLUTION
gist: A travel-book recommendation: Cowen praises Calvin Korponai's "Why Not Bolivia?" for capturing Bolivia's altiplano landscape and La Paz's dramatic descent, and recommends the country as an underrated, original travel destination.

insights.claim: Cowen recommends Calvin Korponai's book "Why Not Bolivia?" (subtitled "From Macchu Picchu into Bolivia in search of the Garden of Eden"), describing Bolivia as a fantastic and more original travel destination than most people expect.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: No direct market relevance; a cultural/travel recommendation consistent with Cowen's recurring book-review content.
insights.quote: Bolivia is a fantastic country to visit, more original than most people are expecting, and this is the book to tell you why.

insights.claim: The excerpted book passage describes El Alto International Airport, sitting on the altiplano at 4,100 meters above the city of La Paz, as the highest international airport in the world.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: No investment relevance; a factual travel detail.
insights.quote: Arriving at El Alto International Airport (which sits on the altiplano above the city at forty-one hundred meters, making it the highest international airport in the world)

insights.claim: Cowen recommends Cochabamba, Bolivia as an amazing food city.
insights.speaker: Tyler Cowen
insights.so_what: No market relevance; a personal travel tip.
insights.quote: Recommended, and yes Cochabamba is an amazing food city.
